summary: Frontend-only validation of IGSS NOG fixes using igss.admin (administrador_igss). (1) Login OK -> lands on /pacientes; navigating to /igss/unidades renders data-testid='unidades-igss-page' with no redirect. (2) Opened NOG manager for unit 'Zona 11' (nogs-unit-18801a0e...), clicked Nuevo NOG, filled QA-UI-38804 / cantidad 5 / precio 100 / tipo 'Compra Directa' -> toast 'NOG creado', row listed with 0/5, 5 disp., Total Q500. (3) Created IGSS patient TEST_QA NogUI (DPI 9097912709371) from /pacientes selecting Zona 11 and NOG QA-UI-38804 (option showed '(5 disp.)') -> toast 'Paciente creado exitosamente'. Back in NOG manager the row showed 1/5, 4 disp.; unit header Acreditados 1 / Disponibles 57; expanding nog-expand showed patient EXP-202610-0013 TEST_QA NogUI in nog-pacientes-<id> with Anular action. Page stat card 'Servicios acreditados' also updated to 1.

issues: Minor/UX suggestion: 'Tipo de Compra' in the patient form is not auto-filled from the selected NOG's tipo_compra (NOG already has it). Not a bug.

critical_code_review_comments: Production issue for point 1 was cached session permissions; consider refreshing permissions from /auth/me on app load (or on 403) so role permission changes take effect without re-login.
